chunks: Then he called out with a loud voice
Al-Jihad, al-Jihad (fighting, fighting), O creatures of Allah! Know that I am mobilizing the army today, so whoever desires to proceed towards Allah should come forward.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say when mobilizing for battle in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this pivotal moment from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) issues a public call to Jihad, emphasizing the voluntary nature of his campaign by inviting those seeking martyrdom and divine proximity to join him. This declaration underscores the Shia understanding of Jihad as both a physical struggle and a spiritual journey toward Allah, reflecting the leadership's readiness to sacrifice for truth. The phrase 'I am encamping today' highlights the immediacy of the call to action, resonating with the concept of active readiness in the face of injustice.
